# NTP

The NTP servers of chrony, and its sync status. `osapi behavior get --name ntp`
and `osapi behavior method get` show the same. [Its chain](../../chains/ntp.md)
shows each call that its examples make.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Description | Get the sync status of chrony and its sources                                                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Reads chronyc tracking, for whether chrony is synchronized, its stratum, its offset from NTP time and the source that it follows, and chronyc sources, for each source that it has. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/ntp                                                                                                                                                  |
| Permission  | ntp:read                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Command     | [osapi client node ntp get](../../../usage/cli/client/node/ntp/get.md)                                                                                                              |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Output type | Status                                                                                                                                                                              |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (5)

| FIELD          | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                         |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| synchronized   | boolean | Whether chrony is synchronized to a source                          |
| stratum        | integer | The NTP stratum of the host                                         |
| offset         | string  | The offset of the system clock from NTP time, such as +0.000003422s |
| current_source | string  | The source that chrony follows now                                  |
| servers        | array   | The sources that chrony has                                         |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                                    | INPUT  | OUTPUT                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| A host synchronized to time.cloudflare.com | (none) | synchronized=true, stratum=3, offset=+0.000003422s, current_source=time.cloudflare.com, servers=\[time.cloudflare.com 0.pool.ntp.org] |
| A host that chrony does not synchronize    | (none) | synchronized=false, offset=-0.000001834s                                                                                              |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Description | Set the NTP servers that chrony uses                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Detail      | Writes a server line for each server to /etc/chrony/sources.d/osapi-ntp.sources, and reloads the sources with chronyc reload sources. A file that has the same servers does not change, and reports changed: false. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/ntp                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Permission  | ntp:write                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Command     | [osapi client node ntp create](../../../usage/cli/client/node/ntp/create.md)                                                                                                                                        |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

### Input (1)

| FIELD   | TYPE  | REQUIRED | DESCRIPTION                                |
| ------- | ----- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| servers | array | yes      | The NTP servers, hostnames or IP addresses |

### Output (1)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE                       | INPUT                                    | OUTPUT        |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| Set two servers               | servers=\[0.pool.ntp.org 1.pool.ntp.org] | changed=true  |
| The servers that the host has | servers=\[0.pool.ntp.org]                | changed=false |
